description: Editing an existing sandbox and the scriptable surface: msbctl edit's EDIT_SECTIONS each reusing the wizard's own pick_* function preselected from current state, set_toml_key() as the comment-preserving single-key editor (never rewrite a whole file), which settings are portable versus machine-local, the rebuild offer, _recover_broken() on an unparseable file, rename_sandbox() and move_project(), per-sandbox secrets written only through set_env_file_value()/try_set_env_file_value(), and the one-shot interfaces (ls/show --json, secret set, setup --claude-token). Use when changing msbctl edit, one of its sections, rename or move, secret storage, or a scripting interface.
